recommendation.label: INFERENCE
recommendation.text: RULED: option A. The binding stage is the grader. The counted book fills at the chain read at decision and loses at that fill whether or not it was first; every replay has been grading the loop at the message's reserves on launches where someone else was first, and that is where all of the control's +201 SOL comes from. Grade every book at the attainable fill, correct the three documents that said otherwise, write the lesson the contract has owed since 10-24, and leave RI-04's contract and its KILL verdict as they stand. Stopping the engine is the operator's call because the engine is the tape.
